turns.assessment: The critical EQPT_CARD_FAIL alarm directly identifies the S15 endpoint of lightpath och28. A card failure there explains both directions: its transmitter is lost at the S01 receiver (OCH_LOS and inbound OCM channel loss), while its own receiver/monitoring becomes invalid. All affected working services depend on och28, protected services switched away, and unchanged amplifier telemetry argues strongly against an OMS-wide line fault.

proposals.rationale: Explicit EQPT_CARD_FAIL at this 400G line interface coincides with the outage. It accounts for loss of och28 in both directions and exactly matches the shared service impact.
